component.name: Melia
component.summary: A private, offline-first email client for Linux

description.p: Melia is a desktop email client for Linux. It connects directly to your IMAP and SMTP servers, with no cloud relay, no telemetry, and no account to create. Messages are stored in a local SQLite database, and your credentials are kept in your OS keyring.

Every message is re-rendered for legibility, with corrected contrast in light and dark mode, padding fixes for messages that would otherwise look broken, and tracking-pixel neutralization so senders cannot tell when you have opened a message.

ul.li: IMAP and SMTP for Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, Fastmail, and any standard mail server
Offline-first: read, search, and queue replies with no connection
Full-text search across every account and folder
Smart dark mode that re-renders each message for legibility
Drag-and-drop folder organization with multi-account sidebar
Compose with rich text, inline images, attachments, and signatures
Desktop notifications, dock unread badge, and EML file viewer

description.p: Melia is free for a single account with no feature limits. A one-time $10 unlock removes the account cap. There is no subscription and no trial.

screenshot.caption: Three-pane inbox view with smart dark mode email rendering
Light mode with the same layout, adapting to your desktop theme
Compose window with rich text formatting and inline links
Advanced search with scope filters across accounts and folders

description.p: Tiling shadow-collapse now covers the full tiling matrix — follow-up to Oto's v1.1.270 retest on Pop!_OS 24.04.

Rebrand from Box to melia, with the same codebase and authorship. Direct IMAP/SMTP, offline-first operation, and smart dark mode rendering are all carried forward. Adds a themed wordmark logo in the title bar with light and dark variants.
